subject: Human Body
title: Burns and Skin Repair
description: A quick win: understand Burns and Skin Repair.

hook.text: A first-degree burn hurts but heals in days. A third-degree burn destroys all skin layers and can't heal on its own.

buildup.text: First-degree: epidermis only. Second-degree: dermis damaged, blisters form.

discovery.text: Third-degree burns require skin grafts. Surgeons take healthy skin from elsewhere and transplant it to cover the wound.

twist.text: Lab-grown skin is now possible. Scientists culture patient cells into skin sheets.

climax.text: Burn severity depends on depth. Shallow burns self-repair.

punchline.text: Deep burns destroy the cells needed for healing. Only grafts can help.

quiz.question: Why are third-degree burns painless at the burn site?
options: Adrenaline blocks all pain during the injury
The nerve endings in the skin are completely destroyed
The brain suppresses pain from severe injuries
